notes: This contract defines portable C++ and Java TCK witnesses for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.13.5's default TLS 1.3 port requirement. The adapter must provide a tls:// RTI Address with no explicit port and a TLS 1.3 listener on the normative default port 15165, plus any trust material required by the selected provider. The scenarios connect through the official APIs and complete List Federation Executions with its report callback. They test the externally observable default-port route only; they do not establish certificate-policy completeness, independent-provider interoperability, or provider-wide conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::connect using an RtiConfiguration RTI Address with the tls:// scheme and no explicit port, followed by List Federation Executions and its report callback
